Synchronization.Description: PROVISIONAL (Q6). StartTime is 0 for every camera. The lab README and the dataset card state the cameras are synchronized, every camera of a session has the same frame count, and the 3D pose is aligned to the videos by frame index. The per-camera timestamps in the file names differ by 6 to 18 s within a session and are kept here as SourceTimestamp. Not part of the BIDS specification.

CameraCalibration.Description: This camera's block of the anipose/sleap-anipose calibration, preserved verbatim. Not part of the BIDS specification.

SourceEncoding.Description: The lab re-encoded this video from an HEVC CRF 12 original before deposit. Frame counts match the original. Pose file names still mention the original encodes. Not part of the BIDS specification.
